_note: Batch 13: ten REAL Perth creative therapy providers researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'creative' practice category: art therapy, music therapy, dance/movement and expressive therapies. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy names registrations (ANZACATA, AMTA/RMT, PACFA) and formats, never client conditions or outcomes — the specialisation lists these practitioners publish (trauma, grief, addictions etc.) are deliberately NOT repeated. Honest gaps: drama therapy has no individually verifiable Perth practice (psychodrama training is east-coast based), and no independent creativity coach with a verifiable practice surfaced — both subtypes await real listings or signups. Dancing Dhevas is described as conscious dance, not therapy, matching how they describe themselves. Koongamia and Bayswater added to Swan Valley & East; Spearwood to Fremantle & South.

listings.name: Art of Therapy
listings.blurb: Aneta Wnek is a Masters-qualified, ANZACATA-registered creative arts therapist working mainly with adults, in individual sessions and small groups. No art skill is expected — the making is the medium, not the point. Referrals and self-managed NDIS participants are welcome, and a free discovery call starts things off.
listings._source: artoftherapy.com.au — practitioner name, MCAT/AThR credentials, ANZACATA registration, adult focus, NDIS self-managed and free discovery call confirmed; suburb, prices and direct contact not published

listings.name: MKLA Creative Arts Therapies
listings.blurb: Michaela Psaila-Savona brings three decades of professional experience to a Masters-trained, ANZACATA-registered art therapy practice seeing children, young people and older adults, individually and in groups, with NDIS participants among her clients.
listings._source: mklacat.com — practitioner name, Masters training, ANZACATA registration, 30 years experience, client ages and email confirmed; the published specialisation list (grief, addictions etc.) is deliberately not repeated; suburb and prices unpublished

listings.name: Claudia Richards Art Therapy
listings.blurb: An ANZACATA-registered art therapist working across three fronts: one-to-one sessions with individuals, programs for community groups, and commissioned work for organisations wanting art therapy in their services.
listings._source: arttherapyperth.com — ANZACATA registration and individual/community/organisation service model confirmed from the site's own description; suburb, prices and contact not captured

listings.name: Peace By Piece Art
listings.blurb: A registered WA charity running community art wellbeing programs — studio sessions, workshops and art and somatic experiences facilitated by peer workers alongside art and somatic therapists. They're explicit that the work complements clinical care rather than replacing it, which says a lot about how they operate.
listings._source: pbp.org.au — charity status (DGR, WA licence CC23697), peer-worker + therapist facilitation model, studio/workshop formats and complement-not-replace-clinical-care positioning confirmed; address, prices and direct contact not published

listings.name: Art 4 Success
listings.blurb: A Perth psychotherapy practice where art therapy and expressive therapy sit alongside talking work — including NDIS art therapy — for people who process better through making and movement than conversation alone.
listings._source: art4success.com — psychotherapy practice offering NDIS art therapy and expressive therapy confirmed from their service list; their EMDR and trauma-therapy marketing is not repeated; suburb, prices and contact not captured

listings.name: Bridie's Music Therapy and Counselling
listings.blurb: Bridie Fitzgerald runs a private studio in the Perth foothills near Midland, registered with both AMTA (music therapy) and PACFA (counselling). Sessions span music therapy, counselling, early-intervention work with young children, and straight-up music lessons — voice, guitar, flute, piano and songwriting. NDIS registered for self and agency-managed participants.
listings._source: bridiesmusictherapyandlessons.com.au — practitioner name, AMTA and PACFA registrations, Koongamia studio, NDIS registration and service list confirmed; prices and direct contact via website form only

listings.name: Sol Music Therapy
listings.address: Victoria Hall, 179 High Street, Fremantle WA 6160
listings.blurb: A private music therapy practice working out of Victoria Hall on Fremantle's High Street, building personalised music therapy programs around each client rather than a set curriculum, with NDIS participants supported.
listings._source: solmusictherapy.com.au plus directory listings — Fremantle Victoria Hall location (an O'Connor address also appears in listings), personalised program model and NDIS work confirmed; prices and direct contact not captured

listings.name: New Song Music Therapy
listings.blurb: A Bayswater-based private music therapy practice run by registered music therapists, working with clients across ages and abilities in clinic and community settings.
listings._source: newsongmusictherapy.com.au — private Perth music therapy practice based in Bayswater confirmed; practitioner names, prices and contact not captured from the pages checked

listings.name: Dancing Dhevas
listings.blurb: Theva Indrasenan has run conscious dance in Perth since 2010 — Open Floor trained, with sessions from $25 Friday-night dances to weekend intensives and dawn 'Morning Medicine' beach dances. Venues cluster around Fremantle: North Fremantle Community Hall, Hilton PCYC, Bibra Lake and South Beach. No steps to learn; the floor is the practice.
listings._source: dancingdhevas.com — founder, Open Floor teacher training (2018), running since 2010, venue list, session types and published prices ($25–40 Friday sessions, $255–350 weekends) confirmed; base address 6 Malcolm Street Spearwood; described as conscious dance, not therapy, matching their own language

listings.name: Wattleseed Centre WA
listings.blurb: A Perth centre offering art psychotherapy delivered by ANZACATA-registered professionals, in a practice where image-making becomes a first language for things that are hard to say out loud.
listings._source: wattleseedcentrewa.com.au/arttherapy — ANZACATA-registered art psychotherapy offering confirmed from their page; suburb, prices and contact not captured
